findings.evidence: The published, proof-bearing theorem has only verification.judge; SCHEMA.md requires verification.audited or verification.verified and states that a judge stamp alone does not satisfy publication checks. Its pointwise superuniformity proof was independently checked and is mathematically sound; an owner audit or valid delegated verification record is needed.

coverage_note: Reviewed both assigned pages, five assigned items, six direct item suppliers, three prerequisite pages, and the batch proof contracts. The transitive foundational dependency proofs of those suppliers were not re-audited. Source locators were checked against [Goeman and Solari, Section 3](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1211.3313), [Fithian, Lecture 26](https://www.stat.berkeley.edu/~wfithian/courses/stat210a/lectures/lecture26-F21.pdf), and [Gregory, Lecture 10](https://people.stat.sc.edu/gregorkb/STAT_713_sp_2023/STAT_713_Lec_10_slides_annotated.pdf).
